thread.title: Top Stocks Apple, Palo Alto Networks Hit Highs, While Align Breaks Out

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Top Stocks Apple, Palo Alto Networks Hit Highs, While Align Breaks Out
text:
The stock market reversed from record highs Tuesday, as the S&P 500 topped 2900 for the first time. The stock market's strong early action resulted in a breakout in IBD 50 stock Align Technology ( ALGN ). But that breakout faded in the stock market today . Meanwhile, top stocks Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) and Apple ( AAPL ) both extended win streaks to five trading sessions.
X
Align broke out past a 385.10 flat-base entry, according to MarketSmith chart analysis. At its 390.19 morning peak, the medical stock advanced more than 2%. But shares shrank to a 0.2% gain in afternoon trade.
Analysts forecast the Invisalign maker's earnings to grow 37% in 2018 and 25% in 2019.
The No. 18-ranked IBD 50 stock's flat base is a later-stage base formation. Late-stage bases are more likely to fail than earlier-stage formations, like first and second stages.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Palo Alto Networks notched another new high Tuesday, rising as much as 1% to 229.62. Shares of the cybersecurity leader are still in the 5% buy range of a flat base's 219.48 buy point.
Bullishly, the stock's relative strength line confirmed the strength of the breakout. It made a new high on Aug. 24 when the stock broke out above the buy point.
Luxembourg-headquartered Globant ( GLOB ) extended its win streak to five trading sessions with a more than 4% rise to 65. Globant stock is extended beyond the 5% buy range of a flat base's 60.07 buy point.
The IT services provider boasts four quarters of accelerating earnings growth — a bullish fundamental metric. In the latest reported quarter, the company's earnings growth measured 54% vs. the year-ago period. Meanwhile, revenues grew 28% to $127.9 million.
Apple Hits New High And Is In Profit-Taking Range The iPhonemaker Apple ( AAPL ) advanced about 1% to its 220.54 high. The Dow stock is trading about 13% above a flat base's 194.30 entry and nearly 23% from a double bottom's 179.04 buy point. Most profits should be taken at the 20%-25% profit-taking level .
